# OMS-MND-261126-17 Visual question bank v1, generated by code (formats 4 to 8)

- Code (tools/visual_bank): vbank.py generator, verify.py independent verifier (re-derives every answer without the generator), preview.py HTML preview. Usage: `python3 vbank.py OUT --seed 261126 --scale 1`, then `python3 verify.py OUT`.

Difficulty inside the agreed band per level (Junior 1-3, University 3-5, Manager 4-6, Senior Manager 5-8, C-Level 7-10). Stored in project files omsaze/mindproof/visual-bank-v1/ (JSONL per level, summary.json, previews). Generated files are not committed.
- DB: none. Loading the items into the question bank is a later step and needs the owner's DB approval.
- Live impact: none.
- Rollback: revert the [OMS-MND-261126-17] commits; delete the output folder.
